name: Ridgepost Capital, Inc
summary: Ridgepost Capital, Inc. operates as a multi-asset class private market solutions provider in the alternative asset management industry in the United States, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company's portfolio of private solutions includes private equity, venture capital, impact investing, and private credit, as well as primary fund of funds, secondary investment, and direct and co-investment services.
